episodes.name: learning_20260418_020134
episodes.content: **Coding Assumptions**: Check assumptions and ambiguity before implementation. Use the simpler path when one exists. Why: silent guesses create rework.

episodes.name: learning_20260418_020134
episodes.content: **Coding Simplicity**: Use the minimum code that solves the requested problem. Never add speculative features or abstractions unless asked. Why: unused flexibility adds maintenance cost.

episodes.name: learning_20260418_020135
episodes.content: **Coding Verification**: Use explicit success checks before editing and verify them after. Never fix a bug without repro and re-test evidence. Why: vague goals hide regressions.

episodes.name: learning_20260408_140624
episodes.content: **SF Browser Canonical Interface**: Use `st browser` as the standard browser UI verification CLI for SummitFlow work. Treat `agent-browser` as an internal implementation detail unless you are maintaining `st browser` itself or using a documented fallback path.

episodes.name: learning_20260301_004902
episodes.content: **Rebuild Before Verify**: Run rebuild.sh with the project name after any code edit before user testing, runtime verification, or commit. Never exempt refactors, deletions, or troubleshooting edits.

episodes.name: chat_2026-03-01T00:49:07.961028+00:00
episodes.content: **Runtime Baseline**: Use native `systemd --user` services for SummitFlow, Agent Hub, Portfolio AI, and Terminal. Keep only PostgreSQL, Redis, and Hatchet in Docker. Use full Docker app stacks only for explicit parity or release checks.

episodes.name: learning_20260314_170648
episodes.content: **Coordination Truth**: Use st pulse for cross-project coordination and st sessions ownership for normalized lane truth. Check raw active sessions separately when you need unmanaged-session visibility.

episodes.name: learning_20260317_140353
episodes.content: **Container Compatibility**: Keep config env-driven, bindings configurable, state externalized, and health endpoints available. Avoid absolute host paths and machine-specific assumptions unless the task explicitly changes container support.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:80 type:anti_pattern status:provisional

episodes.name: learning_20260316_164906
episodes.content: **Proxmox Testbed**: Use davion-gem (192.168.8.233) as test hypervisor. Test VM 100 at 192.168.8.234 (8 cores, 16GB, Docker, Chrome :9222, Lightpanda :9223, onboot=1). SSH: kasadis@234 from prod. API: https://233:8006. Template 9000 is read-only base.

episodes.name: learning_20260301_225618
episodes.content: **Registries First**: Use registries for providers, models, and capabilities when they exist. If one new item requires touching multiple lists, fix the architecture instead of duplicating definitions.

episodes.name: learning_20260421_230025
episodes.content: **Persona tool-surface contract**: Keep Jenny/persona operator surface minimal. Core contract is RWBE plus bash-invoked wrappers. No overlapping direct persona convenience tools. No wrapper-like shadow abstractions without explicit contract update and regression tests. Why: Prevents tool-surface drift, prompt noise, and contradictory runtime vs preview behavior.

episodes.name: learning_20260314_170648
episodes.content: **Prompts Live in DB**: Keep runtime prompts in DB via st prompt; never hardcode them in Python. Keep one canonical durable prompt and move variable context to task prompts or variables.

episodes.name: learning_20260225_162334
episodes.content: **Alembic-Only Migrations**: Use db migrate create for every schema change. Never create raw SQL migrations; legacy SQL migration directories are history only.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:80 type:anti_pattern status:provisional

episodes.name: learning_20260310_155807
episodes.content: **DB Prompts Outrank Files**: Use DB-backed prompts and memory retrieval as the live authority. Never treat checked-in markdown prompt copies as runtime instructions; delete stale copies instead of maintaining parallel references.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:100 type:anti_pattern status:canonical

episodes.name: chat_2026-01-31T16:54:42.553241+00:00
episodes.content: **Tech Debt**: Delete obsolete code instead of wrapping it. Never add compatibility layers, fallback branches, or duplicate sources of truth without demonstrated need.

episodes.name: learning_20260310_145935
episodes.content: **Git Ownership**: Use the agent session to manage routine git state. Never offload normal branch, lane, or standard commit/push steps to the human. Why: git governance stays with the active agent.
episodes.source_description: mandate mandate source:learning confidence:80 status:provisional context:git governance across Codex Claude Agent Hub Jenny

episodes.name: learning_20260311_225906
episodes.content: **Use ST Prompt For Prompt CRUD**: Use st prompt CLI (list|get|create|update|delete|assign) for all routine prompt content edits. Never use Alembic for prompt wording changes. Alembic is only for DDL schema changes and one-time seed bootstraps.
episodes.summary: Use st prompt for prompt CRUD

episodes.name: learning_20260310_160047
episodes.content: **Use ST Cleanup Path**: Use st cleanup path <paths> --recursive for repo-local deletions. Never use raw rm -rf, rmdir, or find -delete inside managed repos when the cleanup command can delete the paths safely.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:100 type:anti_pattern status:canonical
episodes.summary: Use st cleanup path for deletions

episodes.name: learning_20260312_131645
episodes.content: **Prompt Authoring**: Use goal-first agent prompts. Add ordered workflow only when sequence matters, then hard constraints, output contract, and verification. Keep durable instructions in one canonical prompt; move variable context and most examples to task prompts or variables.

episodes.name: learning_20260327_130509
episodes.content: **Cleanup Ownership**: Check checkpoints, branches, lanes, and cleanup state before leaving a repo. Use `commit.sh` and `st cleanup` to clear residue instead of leaving debt for later sessions.

episodes.name: learning_20260309_145158
episodes.content: **Git Hygiene**: Treat orphan and prunable branches as cleanup debt. Use current lane evidence before treating a lane as live, then reconcile review, conflict, and orphan residue through canonical cleanup flows.

episodes.name: learning_20260310_135353
episodes.content: **Raw + Lane Truth**: Check st pulse, st sessions ownership, and st sessions list -s active --include-unassigned before risky multi-agent work. Treat ownership as lane truth and raw sessions as unmanaged-work detection.

episodes.name: chat_2026-02-26T00:32:07.319336+00:00
episodes.content: **Feedback Obligation**: Record feedback when it happens. Use friction, idea, improvement, or praise tags; never batch or skip tool-related feedback.

episodes.name: learning_20260324_114014
episodes.content: **Ghost Lanes**: Use live lane evidence before counting checkpoint or branch residue as active. Never count closure-ready or no-session lanes as safe activity. Why: ghost lanes create false progress and cleanup debt.

episodes.name: learning_20260310_151313
episodes.content: **Checkpoint Commits Must Publish**: Use remote-publishing checkpoint flows only. Never create hidden local-only commits in wrappers, hooks, or orchestrators. Why: ahead-only local work is not preserved in this environment.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:95 type:anti_pattern status:canonical

episodes.name: learning_20260409_142936
episodes.content: **Plan Schema**: Use the live /schemas/plan schema as the source of truth for execution-ready tasks. Run st verify plan.json before st create --plan. Keep prompts and help aligned to the live schema, not stale examples.

episodes.name: chat_2026-02-20T00:13:21.338337+00:00
episodes.content: **Session Events**: Agent Hub stores execution events in session_events table. Types: memory_inject, user_message, assistant_message, tool_use, tool_result, thinking, memory_cite, error. API: GET /api/sessions/{id}/events. CLI: st session-events <session-id> OR st session-events --task <task-id> (auto-resolves linked sessions via observability API). Follow mode: st session-events --task <task-id> -f. Filter: -t tool_use. Ordered by (turn, sequence). Tasks store agent_hub_session_ids[] array.

episodes.name: learning_20260331_004122
episodes.content: **Cleanup Truth**: Never rerun `reconcile` when `cleanup_status` repeats a task already marked `reconciled` or `authoritative,superseded` in `workstream_inventory` unless newer task, git, or session evidence contradicts it. Verify once, then move one truth-bug fix lane or name the blocker.

episodes.name: learning_20260304_191127
episodes.content: **CLI-First**: Fix st, dt, or db when they break. Never work around broken CLIs with raw APIs, curl, or direct DB access.
episodes.summary: Fix broken CLI, never raw API

episodes.name: learning_20260319_171050
episodes.content: **SF Browser Health**: Check `st browser health` before UI verification. If engines are down, start VM 100 with `proxmox-vm.sh start 100` and wait for SSH plus Docker. Never skip UI verification because the test VM is down.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:80 type:anti_pattern status:provisional

episodes.name: chat_2026-03-09T18:53:44.211698+00:00
episodes.content: **Task Authoring**: Use execution-ready task specs at creation. Include objective, why-now, constraints/non-goals, done-when, verification path, concrete scope/files, and a usable subtask breakdown.

episodes.name: learning_20260324_113940
episodes.content: **Wake Dispatch Blocker**: Treat wake or claimed-task dispatch into a non-repo or snapshot-only lane as a persona-owned dispatch/runtime blocker. Confirm once. Never redispatch the same broken path.

episodes.name: learning_20260317_150858
episodes.content: **Hybrid Runtime**: Run first-party apps under systemd --user, keep Docker for shared infra (postgres, redis, hatchet). Use rebuild.sh project-name for all rebuilds and restarts.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:95 type:anti_pattern status:canonical

episodes.name: learning_20260421_222637
episodes.content: **Jenny autonomy envelope**: Keep Jenny autonomy maximal. Limit only on sudo, project tiers, heartbeat cadence, and core safety. No arbitrary self-limits. No fake preference for dispatch over direct work or direct work over dispatch.

episodes.name: learning_20260308_160303
episodes.content: **Coordination Pulse**: Use st pulse as the cross-project coordination overview at session start and before risky edits. Use st pulse --project <project> for drilldown when one project needs detailed task, lane, or session context.

episodes.name: learning_20260317_143251
episodes.content: **Native Restarts**: Use `rebuild.sh <project>` for all service rebuilds/restarts. Project name is required — no cwd auto-detection. Script handles port cleanup, frontend build, migrations, service restart, and health verification.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:80 type:anti_pattern status:provisional

episodes.name: chat_2026-01-31T16:52:15.925162+00:00
episodes.content: **Code Structure**: Extract shared logic after 2 occurrences. Split files over 500 lines. Extract functions over 50 lines. Use named exports only.

episodes.name: learning_20260310_160948
episodes.content: **Host Exec Blocks != CLI Hooks**: Treat command blocks from the surrounding exec tool runtime as host-level enforcement, not proof of native Codex CLI hooks. Attribute local governance only to repo-controlled wrappers, hooks, or registries when code proves it.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:80 type:anti_pattern status:provisional

episodes.name: chat_2026-02-10T14:33:32.904402+00:00
episodes.content: **Backend TDD**: Follow test-first flow for backend changes. Read existing tests, add or adjust coverage, then implement. Validate behavior and error paths cleanly.

episodes.name: learning_20260310_130035
episodes.content: **Memory Format**: Use compact bold topic headers and direct imperative wording. Store one atomic rule per memory episode. Prefer <=3 sentences and <=280 chars unless a slightly longer single episode is clearer than splitting one rule across multiple entries.
episodes.source_description: mandate mandate source:learning confidence:96 status:canonical context:Canonical formatting rule for mandate/guardrail/reference episode content after validator tightening

episodes.name: learning_20260306_183007
episodes.content: **Global Behavior Scope**: Use one global memory for cross-project behavior rules. Never duplicate commit or ownership rules per project or invent a separate human editor without evidence.
episodes.source_description: mandate mandate source:learning confidence:95 status:canonical context:User correction: commit posture and file-ownership assumptions are cross-project behavioral rules an

episodes.name: learning_20260310_174010
episodes.content: **Closeout Requires Cleanup**: Check st cleanup status before any closeout. Never declare completion with orphan or prunable branches. Why: git cleanliness includes cleanup state.
episodes.summary: Run st cleanup status before closeout

episodes.name: learning_20260307_204040
episodes.content: **Operator Context**: Use st done --admin when reconcile or cleanup must finish without checkpoint data. Expect st context to show SPECIALISTS lines from lane_preflight as advisory overlap only. Keep blocking heuristics unchanged.
episodes.source_description: reference reference source:learning confidence:95 status:canonical context:2026-03-07 SummitFlow operator usability follow-up

episodes.name: learning_20260307_204040
episodes.content: **Session Surfaces**: Use st sessions ownership for normalized lane truth via /api/agent-hub/ownership/projects/{project_id}/live. Use st sessions list -s active for raw live sessions via repaired sessions proxy. Do not force row-count parity between those surfaces.
episodes.source_description: reference reference source:learning confidence:95 status:canonical context:2026-03-07 SummitFlow coordination hardening

episodes.name: chat_2026-03-06T15:14:37.663143+00:00
episodes.content: **SF Browser URLs**: Use host_ip from project-index (injected at session start) plus service port for st browser URLs. Never guess IPs. Check `st browser health` before UI work.

episodes.name: learning_20260310_135353
episodes.content: **Overlap Before Blocking**: Run st sessions overlap --project <project> before blocking parallel work in one repo. Never block by repo alone; block only on exact write overlap, shared plumbing, or ambiguous ownership.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:95 type:anti_pattern status:canonical

episodes.name: chat_2026-03-10T12:42:11.376028+00:00
episodes.content: **Bug Tracking**: Use `st capture bug 'Fix: X'` to log bugs immediately. Never use the removed `st bug` command. Why: `st capture` is the canonical lightweight intake path.

episodes.name: learning_20260310_143914
episodes.content: **Codex Integration Path**: Treat Codex automation here as wrapper-driven, not native hooks. Use /home/kasadis/bin/codex plus ~/.codex/session-integrations and do not claim unverified native hook support.

episodes.name: learning_20260328_144504
episodes.content: **Claude Session Patience**: Check `st session-events` or `st sessions show` before declaring an active Claude run stalled. Never redrive a quiet Opus run early. Why: analysis and rate-limit recovery can last 30+ minutes without failure.

episodes.name: chat_2026-02-24T16:56:56.483240+00:00
episodes.content: **Ports**: Use SummitFlow 8001/3001, Agent Hub 8003/3003, Portfolio AI 8000/3000, Terminal 8002/3002, Monkey Fight 4001, PostgreSQL 5432, Redis 6379, Hatchet gRPC 7070, and Hatchet health 8888. Run apps under `systemd --user`; keep only PostgreSQL, Redis, and Hatchet in Docker.
